adn.resume_en: 89% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 7/10), 100% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 7.1/10), 67% sit on a dark background and 33% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 22% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 33% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 7.4/10, mean brightness 4.6/10, mean complexity 7.2/10. Dominant materials: glass 17%, fabric 17%, plastic 14%, chrome 14%. Dominant palette: #FFFFFF, #12161A, #2BE19F, #141917, #59EAA0.

composition: Rule 1: Use a 3-panel grid or asymmetrical split with characters occupying 40-50% of the canvas (typically left or center).
Rule 2: Anchor the bottom 15-20% of the frame with horizontal UI banners, rounded profile badges, or social media handles.
Rule 3: Position a massive 3D monogram or logo on the opposite side of the main character to balance the composition.
Rule 4: Frame characters with luxury sports cars or architectural elements in the mid-ground to establish high-status context.
typographie: Rule 1: Stack heavy, blocky 3D gothic or sans-serif lettering with deep extrusion behind a flowing, vibrant script overlay.
Rule 2: Apply high-gloss metallic textures (chrome, gold, silver) to 3D text, matching the primary accent color.
Rule 3: Use clean, ultra-bold geometric sans-serif fonts for UI elements and secondary text to maintain readability.
lumiere: Rule 1: Apply intense, high-contrast neon rim lighting (green, red, or orange) outlining character silhouettes.
Rule 2: Mix warm overhead streetlights or sunset glows with cold, metallic reflections on 3D surfaces.
Rule 3: Use dramatic key lighting from the side to create deep shadows and high-status cinematic mood.
etalonnage: Rule 1: Dominant dark base of deep charcoal or black (#0A0A0A to #141917) occupying 60% of the canvas.
Rule 2: High-saturation neon accents in emerald green (#2BE19F / #00FF66), crimson red (#E61C24), or warm gold (#E5B842).
Rule 3: Clean white or silver (#FFFFFF / #D1DCD6) for high-contrast text and UI elements.
effets: Rule 1: Layer atmospheric smoke, light leaks, and subtle film grain over the entire composition.
Rule 2: Apply halftone dot patterns and sharp geometric vector overlays to bridge 3D renders with 2D graphic design.
Rule 3: Add realistic lens flares, wet street reflections, and subtle motion blur on floating elements.
logo: Rule 1: Integrate the logo as a physical 3D object in the scene, featuring bullet holes, metallic textures, or neon outlines.
interdits: Avoid flat 2D text without extrusion or metallic shading.
Do not use low-contrast, washed-out backgrounds; keep darks deep and atmospheric.
Avoid symmetrical, centered layouts without a strong balancing element on the sides.
Do not omit the signature neon rim lighting on character silhouettes.
